signature.name: VTask.seminormFromBounded
signature.type: {R : Type u_1} -> [CommRing R] -> {f : R → ℝ} -> {c : ℝ} -> (f_zero : f 0 = 0) -> (f_nonneg : 0 ≤ f) -> (f_mul : ∀ (x y : R), f (x * y) ≤ c * f x * f y) -> (f_add : ∀ (a b : R), f (a + b) ≤ f a + f b) -> (f_neg : ∀ (x : R), f (-x) = f x) -> RingSeminorm R

conventions.statement: The resulting RingSeminorm always maps 0 to 0, as required by the ring seminorm axioms and guaranteed by f_zero.
The resulting seminorm satisfies seminormFromBounded' f 1 ≤ 1 for any admissible f and c; if f is nonzero then equality holds.
An element x satisfies (VTask.seminormFromBounded ...) x = 0 if and only if f x = 0.
If f is nonarchimedean (satisfies f(a+b) ≤ max(f a, f b)), then the resulting seminorm is also nonarchimedean.
